36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
179362: Kinji Ninomiya is a young man overflowing with extreme overconfidence. Right when he thought he was set to live a cushy NEET lifestyle, he was swept off to another world.
206200: Wanibe is a reptilian who took up Kinji on one of his get-rich-quick schemes. Now he's thoroughly wrapped up in Kinji's shenanigans. A helpless guy who mostly ends up getting used as an underling, which suits him just fine.
206201: Rim is a ferocious dragon that often takes the appearance of a little girl. In the exchange for a promise for tasty food, she helps Kinji out. She has a voracious appetite.
215099: Belza Shuba'ha is the Director of Raiza'ha Demonite Mining Corporation, Detmolt branch. She is willing to sacrifice her employees if it will get her results.
215100: Ranga is an effeminite male mage. He followed Kinji Ninomiya from a messed up future in order to knock some sense into his ancestor from current times.
215101: Shia Kinou is one of the main protagonists in Meikyuu Black Company. She is a hero who is known for possessing The Philosopher's Stone by conquering The Fifth Floor of the dungeon.
215102: Goblin Boss is the boss of Kinji Ninomiya in the dungeon mining company.
247287: Meikyuu Ari A is a Labyrinth Ant that serves Kinji Ninomiya.
247953: Maou Is a dungeon guardian of The Dungeon of Black Company!
